name: accessControl
description: Replays OpenZeppelin AccessControl events into the role table V1 writes for 328 contracts: who holds each role and which role administers it. Exists because this output shape is the single most common handler in V1 and cross-project consistency of it comes from fixed code, so the fold lives here rather than in a model-authored plan. Replaces the V1 `accessControl` handler.
input: The result of a `logs` fetch for `RoleGranted(role, account, sender)`, `RoleRevoked(role, account, sender)` and `RoleAdminChanged(role, previousAdminRole, newAdminRole)`, in chain order.

roleNames.description: Optional map from a role hash (`bytes32` hex) to its name, e.g. the value of the `MINTER_ROLE()` getter to `MINTER_ROLE`. Roles without a name are keyed by their hash. The zero hash is always `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`.

output: Object keyed by role name (or hash when unnamed), always including `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`, each `{ adminRole, members }`: `adminRole` is the name or hash of the administering role and defaults to `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`; `members` lists current holders unique in grant order, with a revoked account removed and re-added at the end if granted again.
